Accepted OFF/HYDRO/LIQUID captures show qrs events #1 and #3 at the reported PCs and before/after REAL32 values for P05_00 and P01_00.
The qrs store at 0x25f4e58 is shared across arms; the reported post-clamp values differ, with positive LIQUID remainders and OFF P01_00 later reaching zero at a separate store.
The 0x25f4ae3 branch to 0x25f4dc0 is consistent with ordered xmm15 == 0; the register source is traced only to compiler-managed local scratch storage, not a physical process name.
Later P05_00 HYDRO Q/QC/t buffer changes and the different OFF/LIQUID directions are described as captured storage changes, without a water/energy budget or forecast-cause conclusion.
Runtime write-event PC values are identified as PCs after the watched write; exact store addresses are separately supported by disassembly.
All three internal postprocessing summaries report PASS_SCOPED_CAPTURE_CONTINUITY; each has zero byte differences across 624 selected points, entry/return, and 25 core fields (31,200 comparisons).
Optional refl_10cm entry/return byte differences are OFF 2/2, HYDRO 4/4, LIQUID 4/4; re_cloud, re_ice, and re_snow each compare byte-equal at 624/624 points for both endpoints.
Each arm has 8 inner target points and 16 endpoint rows; watched hardware value-change event totals are OFF 18, HYDRO 14, LIQUID 20.

The LIQUID first-call PRE qr value (2.710022856e-4) is close to HYDRO (2.718877195e-4), a relative difference of about 0.326%; table labeling and caveats keep these as candidate first-PRE buffer values rather than claiming initial NetCDF QRAIN or physical process attribution.

Clean reproduction compares 24 regenerated artifacts byte-identically; historical evidence check confirms 50, 28, 108, and 184 artifacts with matching hashes and sizes.

scope_limits: The linked executable has no DWARF; candidate source names are not proof of exact compiled source identity.
The captured REAL32 q/qrs/qci/t changes are selected storage deltas, not a column mass or energy closure.
No source-level evaporation, condensation, phase-change, or other process attribution is established.
The diagnostic launches intentionally stopped after the first KDM6 call and do not establish forecast completion, precipitation skill, or model-process budget.
Inner postprocessing continuity is scoped to 624 selected keys, 25 core fields, and entry/return; optional-array differences and sampled internal write transitions are reported separately.
